clue.text: Showing off before emotional strain

parts.note: pre- is the Latin-derived prefix meaning before
tension is nervous or emotional strain

explanation.surface: Someone shows off just before cracking under emotional pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: Pretension is an affected claim to importance, a kind of showing off.

clue.text: After game man's seen artist

indicators.note: after places the man's piece behind the game in the answer

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a ball game
Ben's: Ben stands for any man's name, with the possessive S

explanation.surface: After a match, some man spots a painter.
explanation.walkthrough: RU (rugby union) is a common crossword abbreviation for a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Peter Paul Rubens was a Flemish Baroque painter.

clue.text: One has a magazine going around

definitions.text: One has a magazine going around

parts.words: One has a magazine going around
parts.note: reads like a newsagent's rounds, but describes a handgun whose cylinder of cartridges turns

explanation.surface: Someone is passing round a periodical.
explanation.definitionFit: This handgun's rotating cylinder holds the cartridges and turns as it fires, so it goes around.

clue.text: Simple name for author of concordance

parts.note: crude means simple or unrefined

explanation.surface: A plain name for the man who compiled a Bible index.
explanation.walkthrough: Alexander Cruden compiled a famous 18th-century concordance (word index) of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Cruden's Concordance is the classic word index to the King James Bible, compiled by him.

clue.text: Feat's tricky with fog — no performance can be seen there

definitions.text: no performance can be seen there

indicators.note: tricky suggests the letters are handled awkwardly and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, the possessive S counted as a letter here
taken as written

explanation.surface: A stunt in fog proves hard, and nobody can see the show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tricky' rearranges FEATS and FOG into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Behind the scenes, out of the audience's view, nothing is performed.

clue.text: Sign of affection is binding king and son

indicators.note: binding here joins the king to the small word that follows it

parts.note: K is the chess and card abbreviation for king
taken as written

explanation.surface: A loving gesture ties a king to his son.
explanation.definitionFit: A peck on the cheek or lips is a common token of love.

clue.text: In favour of music making a lot of money

parts.note: for means in favour of, as in 'for or against'
a tune is a piece of music

explanation.surface: Supporting music turns out to be very lucrative.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortune is a very large sum of wealth.

clue.text: Start up a business the way Noah did?

explanation.surface: Launching a firm, much as the ark's builder did.
explanation.walkthrough: Noah literally set a crowd of passengers afloat on the ark.
explanation.definitionFit: To launch a firm on the stock market is the idiom; Noah also put a crew of people and animals on the water.

clue.text: Natty group of fliers joined by swimmer

parts.note: RAF is the Royal Air Force, the British air service
a fish is a swimmer

explanation.surface: A smart bunch of airmen are joined by a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Raffish means flashily or rakishly stylish, close to dapper.

clue.text: See excited Scottish girl after greeting from emperor

indicators.note: after puts the greeting ahead of the rest in the answer

parts.note: hail is a greeting, as in 'all hail'

indicators.note: excited means stirred up, so the letters are shaken into a new order

parts.note: lassie is Scots for a girl

explanation.surface: An emperor's greeting sees a Scottish girl getting worked up.
explanation.definitionFit: He was the last Ethiopian ruler with the imperial title, deposed in 1974.

clue.text: Travelling around to organise another do

indicators.note: to organise is to arrange, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Touring about, arranging yet another party.
explanation.definitionFit: Being out touring or journeying is the idiom's meaning.

clue.text: American tucking into his exotic Japanese dish

indicators.note: tucking into puts one piece inside another
exotic means strange, signalling the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An American is eating some of his foreign Japanese food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exotic' rearranges HIS into SHI, and 'tucking into' puts US inside it; 'exotic' looks like it describes the dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Vinegared rice with raw fish is a Japanese speciality.

clue.text: Secret societies not much good keeping lots outside

indicators.note: keeping with outside shows the lots piece holds the other

parts.note: tons means lots, as in 'tons of time'

indicators.note: not much of the word good leaves just its first letter

explanation.surface: Underground societies, not much good, keep crowds out.
explanation.walkthrough: Tongs are Chinese secret societies, often linked with organised crime.
explanation.definitionFit: Chinese criminal brotherhoods are known as tongs.

clue.text: Vehicle is dumped in valley — wreck

parts.note: a van is a vehicle

indicators.note: dumped in means placed inside the valley word

parts.note: a dale is a valley, especially in northern England

explanation.surface: A car has been abandoned in a valley, a wreck.
explanation.definitionFit: To vandalise is to damage or ruin deliberately.

clue.text: Extra money and journalist is far from bored

parts.note: interest is extra money paid on a loan or savings
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: Extra cash and a reporter keep someone very engaged.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying close attention is the opposite of boredom.

clue.text: Cheerful person who breaks little bits off

definitions.text: person who breaks little bits off

explanation.surface: A happy worker who flakes off small fragments.
explanation.definitionFit: Chipper is informal for bright and lively; also one who chips at wood or stone.

clue.text: Painting — after drink artist goes to it

indicators.note: after places the artist behind the drink in the answer

parts.note: port is a fortified wine
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: After a glass, an artist sets to work on a picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A portrait is a painting of a person.

clue.text: Symbol of authority that could get respect

indicators.note: could get suggests the word respect may be turned into something new

explanation.surface: What a monarch holds might earn respect.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch's ceremonial rod signifies royal power.

clue.text: For example, famous cricketer gets to express thanks before meal

parts.note: say means for example, as in 'say, ten'
W.G. Grace was a celebrated Victorian English cricketer

explanation.surface: A great cricketer gives thanks before dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying a short prayer before eating is the custom meant.

clue.text: A chap giving essential help — that's me as crossword setter!

explanation.surface: The Friday setter describes himself as an indispensable helper.
explanation.walkthrough: Robinson Crusoe's loyal servant gives the general sense; the setter also signs as the Friday compiler.
explanation.definitionFit: A loyal right-hand assistant is the idiom; the Friday puzzle's author is literally the Friday man.

clue.text: Plan haunt to accommodate revolutionary soldiers

indicators.note: to accommodate means to hold inside, so the haunt takes in the soldiers

parts.note: a den is a haunt or lair

indicators.note: revolutionary means turning round, so the soldiers word is read backwards

parts.note: GIs are American soldiers

explanation.surface: Scheme to have a hideout house some rebel troops.
explanation.definitionFit: A design is a plan or scheme.

clue.text: Excellent butter taken round for lady

indicators.note: taken round means turned about, so the whole run reads backwards

parts.note: A1 means first-class, with the 1 read as an I
a ram butts with its head

explanation.surface: Excellent butter is passed round for the woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken round' turns AIRAM into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's name stands for lady here.

clue.text: Rock means first half of walk is upset

indicators.note: first half of limits the turning to the opening three letters of the walk word
is upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so that stretch reads backwards

parts.note: a ramble is a walk

explanation.surface: A stone suggests a stroll got off to a bad start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first half of' and 'is upset' turn only RAM within RAMBLE, giving MAR, while BLE stays as it is.
explanation.definitionFit: Marble is a metamorphic rock.

clue.text: A king receiving honour gives cautionary signal

indicators.note: receiving means taking in, so the honour goes inside

parts.note: R is Rex, Latin for king
MBE is a British honour, Member of the Order of the British Empire

explanation.surface: A monarch accepting a decoration sends out a warning.
explanation.definitionFit: The middle traffic light warns drivers to prepare to stop.

clue.text: Prohibition? Gee, a blow!

parts.note: a ban is a prohibition
gee is the spoken name of the letter G

explanation.surface: A ban? Goodness, what a shock!
explanation.definitionFit: A bang is a sharp knock or hit.

clue.text: Male teacher awards said to be unexpected things

indicators.note: said means spoken aloud, so the words are a sound-alike

parts.note: pupils call a male teacher sir, and his awards are prizes

explanation.surface: A schoolmaster's honours are reported to be a shock.
explanation.definitionFit: Surprises are events nobody anticipated.

clue.text: Pulling relatives into an element of Chinese philosophy

indicators.note: into puts the relatives inside the other piece

parts.note: yang is the active principle paired with yin in Chinese thought
kin are relatives

explanation.surface: Dragging family members into Chinese thought.
explanation.definitionFit: Yanking means pulling sharply.

clue.text: Old king holding on in institution

indicators.note: holding means containing, so the king takes the other piece inside

parts.note: Old King Cole is the merry old soul of the nursery rhyme
on is the leg side in cricket, the half of the field behind the batter's legs

explanation.surface: An ancient monarch keeps going in an establishment.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, on side and leg side are the same half of the field.
explanation.definitionFit: A college is an educational institution.
